name: Keycloak
role: Identity and access management providing signed identities and access tokens for agents and reviewers.

name: Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit
role: Runtime governance toolkit intercepting tool calls before they enter our centrally governed execution path.

name: Open Policy Agent (OPA)
role: Policy engine evaluating deterministic allow/deny rules for actions, budgets, context and operational restrictions.

name: OpenFGA
role: Fine-grained authorization service deciding whether a particular agent may act on a particular record.

name: Temporal
role: Durable workflow engine maintaining process progress, human approval waits and bounded retries.

name: CISO Assistant Community
role: Governance, risk and compliance platform holding our risk register, control ownership, treatment and linked evidence.

name: OpenMetadata
role: Metadata platform supplying data ownership, classification and lineage for trusted workflow context.

name: MLflow
role: Model lifecycle platform connecting versioned evaluation evidence, candidate artifacts and approved release records.

name: OpenBao
role: Secrets-management platform separating credential access for the gateway, workflow worker and evidence dispatcher.

name: OpenTelemetry
role: Observability framework exporting minimized execution spans so decisions and outcomes can be traced.

name: Prometheus + Alertmanager
role: Monitoring and alerting products turning decision, failure and delivery-backlog metrics into operational signals.

name: DFIR-IRIS
role: Incident-response platform receiving customer-scoped alerts and supporting investigation, containment and recovery.

name: GLPI
role: IT service-management and asset platform linking workflows to owned services and trackable remediation tickets.

name: PostgreSQL
role: Transactional database coordinating business state, shared limits, approvals, audit records and delivery receipts.

name: Fairlearn
role: Responsible-AI evaluation library calculating group-outcome differences and producing versioned validation evidence.

name: Kubernetes + Cilium
role: Workload and network-security platforms isolating the agent and restricting its permitted network routes.

name: Syft + Grype + Cosign
role: Software-supply-chain tools inventorying built images, checking vulnerabilities and signing/verifying release artifacts.

name: Ollama + Qwen
role: Local agent inference and bounded tool selection; observations drive the next step while the gateway independently authorizes effects.
